welcome.title: One finger at a time
welcome.text: Steps without windows come first: do what each one says with your fingers while the cameras record your hands. Then windows will appear in front of you: they don't move or click.|Press the button on the right side of the headset to start each step. Pressed while recording, it pauses.

done.title: All done
done.text: Thank you! This recording session will close. Continue in the application.|Review your recordings in the Hand recorder window.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.text: What was recorded so far is saved. Review it in the Hand recorder window.

sections.title: Hand size
sections.intro: First, your hand size: both hands up about 40 cm out, still.

prompts.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Palms toward you

switch.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Backs toward you

sections.title: One finger at a time
sections.intro: Move each finger on its own, mostly with your palm toward you, near and far. Keep the other fingers as still as you can. There's no wrong way: what helps is every finger moving all the way, on its own.

prompts.text: Right hand up, palm toward you, about 40 cm out. Bend each finger all the way down and back up,|one at a time, thumb to little finger. Keep the others still.
Left hand up, palm toward you, about 40 cm out. Bend each finger all the way down and back up,|one at a time, thumb to little finger. Keep the others still.
Right hand close, palm toward you, about a forearm's length from your eyes.|One finger at a time, all the way down and back up.
Left hand close, palm toward you, about a forearm's length from your eyes.|One finger at a time, all the way down and back up.
Right hand, palm toward you. Bend only the fingertip's knuckle, then only the base knuckle,|wiggle fingers sideways, spread them in pairs, cross the index over the middle.
Both hands up, palms toward you. Move a different finger on each hand at the same time,|never the same one on both.
One hand, palm toward you. Keep moving fingers one at a time while the hand travels:|to the edge of your view, low, high, close to your face and back out.
Now the back of the hand toward you, fingers up.|One finger at a time, down and back up.

sections.title: One finger pokes
sections.intro: A window close to you. Poke each lit button with the finger it names, keeping the other fingers out of the way. Nothing happens when you do: the cameras record your hand.

prompts.text: Right hand: poke the lit button with the finger it names, and only that finger.|This window is close: about a forearm's length from your eyes.
